sentences.text: The brief allegation in the FIR is that the informant 's daughter was raped by the present petitioner when she went to collect fire wood.
On perusal of the case diary , it is seen that medical report is not available and the victim girl has been examined after 15 days.
The victim girl in her statement under Section 164 CrPC has implicated the present petitioner.
The petitioner is named in the FIR.
This Court finds sufficient prima facie incriminating material against the petitioner.
Therefore, this Court is of the opinion that it is not a fit case to grant the privilege of pre- arrest bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the pre-arrest bail application stands rejected.

This disposes of the anticipatory bail application JUDGE Comparing Assistant Gobinda Das vs The State Of Assam on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9683430/
